---
title: "Survey research for your studies"
description: "Guidance for students conducting a survey study: choose and adapt an example, write the questionnaire and analysis plan, collect and check responses, and produce the study report."
---

This page is for a student conducting a survey for a course, a dissertation
or a thesis. It takes you from an example study to your own report. Your
supervisor and ethics committee may ask for the documents named at each step.

## Your steps

1. **Set up.** Install R, RStudio and surveyframe as the
   [Get started](../start.html) page shows.
2. **Choose an example close to your study.** The
   [questionnaire templates](../templates.html) are grouped by field. Each
   holds a questionnaire and an example analysis plan to adapt.
3. **Adapt the questionnaire.** Open the example in SurveyStudio, edit the
   questions on the Design screen and press **Save to Studio**.
   [Question types](question-types.html) explains which question fits each
   kind of answer.
4. **Write your analysis plan.** On the Plan screen, record each research
   question, what you expect to find, the measurements and the method.
   [The analysis plan](analysis-plan.html) explains each part.
5. **Share the plan before collecting.** On the Report screen, press
   **Export pre-analysis plan** and give it to your supervisor or ethics
   committee with the `.sframe` file.
6. **Collect and check responses.** The Collect screen gives you the survey
   web page. Load the responses on the Responses screen and review them on
   the Quality screen.
7. **Analyse and report.** Run the planned analyses on the Analyse screen,
   write your interpretation and export the APA 7 report. If you changed the
   plan, the report lists each amendment with its reason.
